description: Phase 6by gate — two interacting bugs surfaced by `random/aggregates/*` and `random/groupby/*` residuals in the 2026-04-20 rust corpus v2. (1) `SELECT *` with GROUP BY emitted zero output rows because `compile_select_aggregated` collapsed `Projection::Star` to an empty proj_exprs slice, so `num_proj = 0` → no result slots. Fix: expand Star to an explicit `Expression::ColumnRef` list (leaked to satisfy the 'src AST lifetime) before calling `compile_grouped_aggregated`. Bare-column refs outside the GROUP BY key set are already handled by Phase 6bo. (2) LEFT JOIN followed by a CROSS/INNER JOIN (the `tab2 LEFT JOIN tab0 ON 0, tab1` shape producing 27 rows instead of 9×3×3=81 from the distinct-star hash fixture) lost the downstream cross-product at the LEFT-null-fill tail. `emit_join_scan_n` previously emitted one terminal body at `threshold=i` when a LEFT step saw no matches, skipping the nested levels (i+1)..n. Fix: at each LEFT-null-fill tail, emit `emit_nested_null_fill` which re-enters the (i+1)..n loops with a per-cursor null mask (cursor i forced NULL; cursors > i emit real values). The `emit_body_with_threshold` callback signature gained a `u64 extra_null_mask` parameter so the deepest emit can distinguish 'cursors >= threshold are NULL' (legacy trailing-null semantics) from 'cursors flagged in mask are NULL' (nested per-cursor null). No new VDBE opcodes. max_invariant=43 unchanged.

cases.name: select-star-group-by-returns-rows
cases.description: Pre-fix: `SELECT * FROM t GROUP BY k` returned zero rows (Projection::Star + GROUP BY hit the empty-proj_exprs branch). Post-fix: returns one row per group with all columns (non-key columns take any value from the group; Phase 6bo bare-column handling).

program.sql: CREATE TABLE t(a INTEGER, b INTEGER, c INTEGER);
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT * FROM t GROUP BY a, b, c);

cases.name: select-star-group-by-all-keys
cases.description: Each row unique on all columns → 3 groups, 3 output rows.

program.sql: CREATE TABLE t(a INTEGER, b INTEGER, c INTEGER);
SELECT * FROM t GROUP BY a, b, c ORDER BY a;

cases.name: select-star-group-by-single-key-bare-col
cases.description: Grouping by one key; bare-column values in output are implementation-defined per Phase 6bo (any row within the group). Check row count only.

program.sql: CREATE TABLE t(a INTEGER, b INTEGER);
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT * FROM t GROUP BY a);

cases.name: left-join-false-on-then-cross
cases.description: Corpus shape `A LEFT JOIN B ON FALSE, C`. A has 3 rows, B has 3, C has 3. LEFT JOIN emits 3 rows with B nulled (no matches), then CROSS JOIN with C produces 3×3=9 rows. Pre-fix returned 3 (downstream levels skipped at null-fill).

program.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM a LEFT JOIN b ON 0, c;

cases.name: left-join-false-on-then-cross-values
cases.description: Values check: B columns must be NULL; C columns must be real.

program.sql: SELECT * FROM a LEFT JOIN b ON 0, c ORDER BY z;

cases.name: left-join-true-on-then-cross-unchanged
cases.description: Regression check: LEFT JOIN ON TRUE + CROSS continues to produce the cartesian product. 3×3×3 = 27 rows.

program.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM a LEFT JOIN b ON 1, c;
